# Health

Check the health of the controller. `osapi dsl endpoint get --name health` shows
the same.

## Endpoint group

|             |                                    |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Name        | health                             |
| Description | Check the health of the controller |
| Area        | fleet                              |

### Methods (3)

| NAME     | VERB | PATH               | PERMISSION    | OPERATION ID    |
| -------- | ---- | ------------------ | ------------- | --------------- |
| liveness | GET  | /api/health        | none (public) | GetHealth       |
| ready    | GET  | /api/health/ready  | none (public) | GetHealthReady  |
| status   | GET  | /api/health/status | health:read   | GetHealthStatus |

| -------- | ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| liveness | LivenessInput                       | Response &#123; status &#125;                                                                                                             |
